energy.text: James made lowering utility costs for fire-country residents one of her highest priorities.
energy.quote: Families in fire country shouldn’t pay the highest energy rates in the state, so wildfire resilience and utility relief come first.

tax.text: She pledges to suspend the state gas tax to make California more affordable for middle-class families.
tax.quote: Heather will fight to suspend the gas tax and make California more affordable for middle-class families.

safety.text: She says she backs the blue and will ensure law enforcement has the resources it needs.
safety.quote: our law enforcement departments have the resources they need to keep us safe

guns.text: She authored a pro-Second Amendment bill and was named the California Rifle & Pistol Association Legislator of the Year.
guns.quote: earning recognition as California Rifle & Pistol Association Legislator of the Year

abortion.text: She identifies as pro-life and opposes California's abortion laws allowing late-term abortions.
abortion.quote: She opposes California's extreme sanctuary state abortion laws that allow unrestricted late-term abortions and cost taxpayers millions.

energy.text: She says she would suspend the gas tax to reduce fuel costs.
